📅 Event Date: 09/06-09/10

A special comeback event just for A/B/C/D/E/F/G & N/N0 hosts who received salary in June OR July OR August

🎮 PK Count Daily Leaderboard
Battle it out in PKs — only fully completed PK sessions will count toward your leaderboard score

Rewards for Top 30 EVERY DAY
🥇 No.1 can win up to 1,500 beans/day

Watch Hour Leaderboard (5-Day Total)
Rank based on total watch hours from 09/06-09/10
🏆 Top 10 hosts will be rewarded — up to 10,000 beans

💰 Beans Received Leaderboard 
Rank by beans received from 09/06-09/10
🥇 No.1 wins 20,000 beans — rewards for Top 10!

🎡 Lucky Spin – Every Day!
Complete your daily level-up task + stream for 45 mins to unlock 1 spin
Spin for a chance to win:
Beans (2,000 / 500 / 100)
Virtual gifts
Surprise merch 🎁

🙌 Not into PKs? No worries!
Go live for just 5 minutes and claim an exclusive limited-time avatar pendant!

👇We’re still offering one Spin & Win chances —Try your luck and see what you’ll get! 🍀✨

 ①Beans Received Spin
💰 Every 100 Beans received = 1 spin
🎉 Win up to 2,000 Beans or a limited-edition Dino!
